init_from_known_poses: init camera poses and depthmaps for all images when ground truth poses are already known
init_minimum_spanning_tree: init all camera poses using a minimum spanning tree over pairwise confidence scores
init_from_pts3d: init pairwise and image poses from a precomputed set of 3D points and focal estimates
minimum_spanning_tree: build a minimum spanning tree to estimate 3D points, focals, and poses from pairwise predictions
fast_pnp: estimate camera pose and focal length from 3D points using RANSAC-based PnP solving
